propositions: ProductionBatchRunner.run receives req.usd_budget as a cost cap override but cannot apply it because shed_to_budget computes the cap internally via plan_budget_cap with no injection point.

The environment variable REBAR_PLAN_REVIEW_BUDGET is not a true cap override because it is read as a base and then centrality-scaled, whereas an explicit override must be the final cap used verbatim without scaling.

An optional cap_override parameter must thread through ProductionBatchRunner.run → run_pass1 → shed_to_budget, defaulting to None to preserve existing byte-identical behavior, and be selected via 'is None' rather than falsiness to honor explicit 0.0 as a real cap.
coverage["budget"] must record cap_source as 'override' or 'computed' to make observable which cap governed a run.
The plan-review gate YAML currently sets no usd_budget on its finders batch, so live gate behavior remains unchanged and this ticket builds only the seam.
